description: This file defines the ContentServices class, providing various static methods for content management operations such as finding related content, traversing content trees, managing content associations, rendering content as text, linking content, publishing content, and utility functions for string manipulation and URL encoding within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ContentServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for content management operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: findRelatedContent
methods.description: Finds content related to the current content, with optional permission checks and filtering by association types and content types.

methods.name: findContentParents
methods.description: Traverses content relationships to find parent content nodes.

methods.name: walkParentTree
methods.description: Recursively walks through parent nodes in a content tree to build a list of parent content IDs.

methods.name: traverseContent
methods.description: Traverses a content tree starting from a specified content ID, returning the node map and pick list.

methods.name: deactivateContentAssoc
methods.description: Deactivates a content association by setting its thruDate to now.

methods.name: deactivateContentAssocMethod
methods.description: Performs the deactivation of a content association with permission checks.

methods.name: deactivateAssocs
methods.description: Deactivates other active associations related to a specific content ID and map key.

methods.name: renderSubContentAsText
methods.description: Renders subcontent associated with a content ID and map key as text.

methods.name: renderContentAsText
methods.description: Renders content associated with a content ID as text.

methods.name: linkContentToPubPt
methods.description: Links or unlinks content to a publication point, managing content status and associations.

methods.name: publishContent
methods.description: Sets the content status to published.

methods.name: getPrefixedMembers
methods.description: Extracts members from a map with keys starting with a specified prefix.

methods.name: splitString
methods.description: Splits an input string into a list based on a delimiter.

methods.name: joinString
methods.description: Joins a list of strings into a single string with a delimiter.

methods.name: urlEncodeArgs
methods.description: URL-encodes a map of arguments into a query string.
